profile.summary: Genesys Works Bay Area is the Bay Area site of Genesys Works, a program that prepares high school students from underserved communities for careers. Students complete about eight weeks of business and technology skills training, then hold a paid internship at a partner company. They also receive college and career coaching, and alumni support after graduation.

review.notes: The cited Genesys Works Bay Area page is the Oakland local site of the national nonprofit and describes paid student internships, matching OUSD's No Cost Services Agreement for the ECCCO Student Internship Program. The summary, phone, email, address and headquarters all match the page; the email is a generic business address and the summary is neutral.
